answer: Quadratic staking erosion, enforced through substantial collateral lockups, ensures Sybil resistance by demanding super-linear capital expenditure for an attacker to forge a majority, exponentially increasing marginal attack costs. Consequently, the negative expected utility of an attack sustains protocol-level integrity against distributed adversaries.
